newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Thakral group buys Melbourne Hilton on Park.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Thakral group buys Melbourne Hilton on Park.

text.p: Thakral Holdings Ltd, Australia's largest hotel owner and part of the Singapore-based Thakral Group, said on Monday it had bought a half share in the Hilton on the Park Hotel in Melbourne.
The other half share was purchased by Thakral Corp Ltd. Total consideration was A$59 million.
The company said the vendor was Golden Century International and the contract was signed by the unlisted Pacific Century Hotels Trust in which each Thakral operation has a half share.
It said the Melbourne hotel has 430 rooms and described the city as a growth market. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
